page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/agent.md` for the full workflow. Determines invocation mode (chat-driven, autonomous, or dual-mode) and Agent name from the request, checks `.github/agents/` for an existing match, and either authors a new Agent (persona, scope boundaries, tools declaration, task input contract, and — for chat-driven — Intent Classification and Routing Table) or revises the existing file(s) in place, re-justifying any broadened tool grants. Ends with a convergence pass per `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md`.
